whyItMatters: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an `engines` block that names no npm version.
actions: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix an `engines` block that names no npm version.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm package.json no longer carries an `engines` block that names no npm version.
